intro: All verses are in common meter, so they fit any CM tune (Amazing Grace, ST. ANNE “O God Our Help”, etc.). Lines 2 and 4 rhyme in every verse.

items.label: Psalm 1
items.title: Psalm 1 (tightened)
items.html:
Verse 1
How blessed is the one who will
Not walk in wicked ways,
Nor stand with sinners, nor sit down
Where scoffers spend their days.

Verse 2
But in the law of God the Lord
His heart finds its delight;
Upon His Word he meditates
By day and through the night.

Verse 3
He’s like a tree by waters set,
Whose fruit in season grows;
Its leaf stays green, and all he does
In blessing overflows.

Verse 4
The wicked are not so at all,
Like chaff the wind blows past;
They will not stand when judgment comes,
Nor join the saints at last.

Verse 5
The Lord knows well the righteous way
And keeps it to the end,
But wicked roads shall perish all
And to destruction tend.

items.label: Psalm 2
items.title: Psalm 2
items.html:
Verse 1
Why do the nations rage and roar,
The peoples plot in vain?
The kings rise up against the Lord
And His Anointed’s reign.

Verse 2
“Come, let us break their bands apart
And cast away their cords!”
So cry the princes of the earth,
The proud and lofty lords.

Verse 3
The One enthroned in heaven laughs,
He holds their plots in scorn;
Then speaks in anger, and they quake,
Their crowns and counsel torn.

Verse 4
“But I have set My King,” He says,
“On Zion’s holy hill.”
I will declare the Lord’s decree
And tell His sovereign will:

Verse 5
“You are My Son,” the Lord declares,
“This day I bring You forth;
Ask Me, the nations are Your own,
From south to farthest north.”

Chorus
How blessed are all who hide in Him,
Who shelter in the Son;
The kings may rage, but God’s decree
Has crowned His Holy One.

Verse 6
“You’ll break them with an iron rod
And shatter all their pride,
Like clay a potter’s hand has thrown
And cast in shards aside.”

Verse 7
So now be wise, you kings of earth,
Be warned, you judges all;
Serve God with fear, rejoice with awe,
Before His throne now fall.

Verse 8
O kiss the Son, lest anger burn
And you should lose the way;
His wrath is kindled in a breath,
So bow to Him today.

Chorus
How blessed are all who hide in Him,
Who shelter in the Son;
The kings may rage, but God’s decree
Has crowned His Holy One.

items.label: Psalm 3
items.title: Psalm 3
items.html:
Verse 1
O Lord, how many are my foes,
How great their swelling throng!
How many say, “No help for him
From God,” and mock me long.

Verse 2
But You, O Lord, a shield to me,
My glory and my crown,
You lift my head when I am low
And bowed with sorrow down.

Verse 3
I cried aloud unto the Lord,
And from His holy hill
He answered me and heard my plea;
He hears His people still.

Chorus
Salvation to the Lord belongs,
It comes from Him alone;
Lord, let Your blessing ever rest
On those You call Your own.

Verse 4
I laid me down and slept in peace,
I woke, and I was kept;
The Lord sustained me through the night
Though foes around me crept.

Verse 5
I will not fear ten thousand foes
Arrayed on every side;
Arise, O Lord, and rescue me,
O God, in whom I hide.

Verse 6
You strike my foes upon the cheek,
You break the wicked’s teeth;
The proud who rose against Your own
Lie broken underneath.

Chorus
Salvation to the Lord belongs,
It comes from Him alone;
Lord, let Your blessing ever rest
On those You call Your own.

items.label: Psalm 4
items.title: Psalm 4
items.html:
Verse 1
Hear me, O God, when I call out,
My righteousness and stay;
You freed me when distress hemmed in;
Be gracious when I pray.

Verse 2
How long, O sons of men, will you
Turn glory into shame?
How long will you pursue vain things
And love what lies proclaim?

Verse 3
But know the Lord has set apart
The godly as His own;
The Lord will hear me when I call
And answer from His throne.

Verse 4
So tremble, and from sin refrain;
Upon your bed be still;
Search out your heart in silent night
And bow before His will.

Chorus
In peace I’ll lay me down and sleep,
For You alone, O Lord,
Make me to dwell in safety here,
My keeper and reward.

Verse 5
Bring offerings of righteousness
And trust the Lord each day;
Forsake the idols you have loved
And walk in His good way.

Verse 6
Though many ask, “Who’ll show us good?”
Lord, let Your face shine bright;
Lift up on us Your countenance
And fill us with its light.

Verse 7
You’ve put more gladness in my heart
Than they have ever known
When grain and wine abound for them
And all their wealth has grown.

Chorus
In peace I’ll lay me down and sleep,
For You alone, O Lord,
Make me to dwell in safety here,
My keeper and reward.

items.label: Psalm 5
items.title: Psalm 5
items.html:
Verse 1
Give ear unto my words, O Lord,
Consider how I sigh;
My King and God, to You I pray,
O hear my pleading cry.

Verse 2
At morning, Lord, You’ll hear my voice;
At dawn my prayer I bring,
And there I’ll wait and watch for You,
My Maker and my King.

Verse 3
You are no God who takes delight
In wickedness and wrong;
No evil dwells with You; the proud
Can’t stand before You long.

Verse 4
You hate all those who practice sin,
You’ll ruin all who lie;
The bloody and deceitful man
Is hateful in Your eye.

Verse 5
But I, by Your unfailing love,
Will enter where You dwell;
In fear toward Your holy shrine
I’ll bow, Your praise to tell.

Chorus
But let all those who hide in You
Be glad and ever sing;
Spread over them Your sheltering hand,
Who love Your name, O King.

Verse 6
Lead me, O Lord, in righteousness,
Because of all my foes;
Make straight Your way before my face
Where’er my journey goes.

Verse 7
For in their mouths there is no truth,
Destruction fills their heart;
Their throat an open grave, their tongues
Smooth flattery impart.

Verse 8
Declare them guilty, O my God,
And by their schemes let fall;
Cast out the rebels for their sins,
Who will not heed Your call.

Chorus
But let all those who hide in You
Be glad and ever sing;
Spread over them Your sheltering hand,
Who love Your name, O King.

Verse 9
For You will bless the righteous, Lord,
Your favor is their shield;
You compass them on every side,
And they shall never yield.

items.label: Psalm 6
items.title: Psalm 6 (penitential)
items.html:
Verse 1
O Lord, do not rebuke in wrath,
Nor chasten me in ire;
Be gracious, for I waste away;
My bones are racked with fire.

Verse 2
O heal me, Lord; my soul is vexed,
Is troubled to the core;
But You, O Lord—how long, how long
Must I wait at Your door?

Verse 3
Return, O Lord, deliver me;
O save me, Lord, I plead,
Not for my worth, but for Your love
That’s steadfast in my need.

Verse 4
In death no one remembers You;
In Sheol, who gives praise?
So spare my life, that I may lift
My song through all my days.

Verse 5
I’m weary with my groaning, Lord;
All night my tears are shed;
I flood my couch with weeping sore
And drench with grief my bed.

Verse 6
My eye grows dim and wastes with grief,
Worn out by all my foes;
Through endless nights of sorrow, Lord,
My weeping overflows.

Chorus
Away from me, you evil ones!
The Lord has heard my cry;
The Lord has heard my weeping voice,
And He will not pass by.

Verse 7
The Lord has heard my plea for help,
My prayer He will receive;
My enemies, in sudden shame,
Shall tremble, turn, and leave.

Chorus
Away from me, you evil ones!
The Lord has heard my cry;
The Lord has heard my weeping voice,
And He will not pass by.

items.label: Psalm 7
items.title: Psalm 7
items.html:
Verse 1
O Lord my God, I hide in You;
From all pursuers save,
Lest lion-like they tear my soul
And drag it to the grave.

Verse 2
If I have done this, Lord my God,
If guilt my hands should fill,
If I’ve repaid my friend with wrong
Or robbed my foe at will,

Verse 3
Then let my foe pursue my soul
And catch me as I run,
And trample down my life to earth,
My honor all undone.

Verse 4
Arise, O Lord, in anger, rise
Against my raging foes;
Awake for me, the judgment, Lord,
That You Yourself impose.

Verse 5
Let all the peoples gather round;
Return, O Lord, on high;
You judge the nations—judge me, Lord,
As one who would not lie.

Verse 6
O end the wicked’s evil ways,
And make the righteous stand;
O righteous God, You search the heart
And weigh what men have planned.

Verse 7
My shield is God, who rescues all
The upright ones in heart;
God is a righteous Judge; His wrath
Each day will not depart.

Verse 8
If one will not repent, God whets
His sword and bends His bow;
He readies deadly arrows, tipped
With fire, against His foe.

Verse 9
The wicked labors with his sin,
With mischief he is great;
He gives birth to deceit and lies,
The fruit of all his hate.

Verse 10
He digs a pit and makes it deep,
Then falls into his snare;
His mischief turns upon his head,
His violence falls there.

Chorus
I’ll thank the Lord, for He is just,
And righteous are His ways;
I’ll sing unto the Lord Most High
And to His name give praise.
